title: Retrospective Neurovascular Anomaly (RENOVA) – Study Genetic Analyses
summary: The aim of this study is to investigate whether molecular biomarkers exist that can predict the occurrence of vasospasm after SAH. This field of research is relevant for anaesthesiology, intensive care medicine and pain therapy, as patients with severe disease progression caused by vascular abnormalities are treated in intensive care units. Biomarkers that can predict severe progression help us to start targeted therapy at an early stage and thus improve the outcome of treatment.

interventions.name: The present study is based on a patient cohort from various neurosurgical intensive care units across Germany.
